answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, but evidence of coordinated equivocation links their faults into one event: for k sybil identities, the penalty grows as O(k^2), rather than linearly, exhausting shared economic backing. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, so a swarm costs far more than it can gain; grove, willow, and mesa attestations may expose correlation, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery.
